title: Runway Briefing — United's Rough Day, Kirby's Chicago Prediction, and Frontier Plays Both Sides
summary: A United flight from LA to Newark turns into a two-stop odyssey after an engine issue forces a diversion to Vegas. United's CEO doubles down on his prediction that American will eventually bail on Chicago. Frontier makes Diamond status easier to reach while quietly gutting everyone else's perks. Plus, Boeing's engineers just said "no thanks" to the latest contract, and two air traffic controllers are getting fired over the LaGuardia crash.
